title: Critical Non-Hermitian Skin Effect and Scale-Free Localization Morphing in Bilocally Coupled Hatano-Nelson Chains
summary: We investigate the critical non-Hermitian skin effect (CNHSE) and the coupling-driven morphing of scale-free localization (SFL) in two Hatano-Nelson chains coupled locally at two bulk sites separated by an inclusive distance d. At weak interchain coupling, competition between the opposite skin accumulations of the two chains generates a geometrically selected critical branch with a complex loop-like spectrum and scale-free skin states localized near the physical boundaries.
